source_pin.fetch_mode: Pinned recursive tree plus candidate raw Java only; no textures/models downloaded

trigger: DevotedBelieversHandler static initialization used during actual EnigmaticLegacy loadComplete logging and live eligibility queries; network loader attempted in source, never executed by this audit.
input: Externally authored name->UUID membership JSON from repository default branch or prior local enigmatic_persistence.dat encoded text snapshot; current player UUID.
output: Whole171line handler first resolves GitHub default branch then reads membership JSON, converts UUIDs, attempts whole-file backup in game directory and returns new map even if backup IOException. If fetch throws IOException only, it attempts existing local backup and reconstructs same map by reversible per-character offset. Missing backup or backup IOException yields empty map. Static final map chosen once per classloader session. UUID values, not names, determine eligibility. SuperpositionHandler.isTheBlessedOne accepts hardcoded architect UUID or cached membership; actual registered CosmicScroll canEquip calls parent duplicate-equipment guard plus this eligibility, real server LivingDeath event grants halfhealth and protection effects/cooldown when eligible and scroll equipped. onEquip grants achievement only for member; login obscuredscroll advancement uses blessed predicate. Thus saved fallback affects real item qualification and death consumer, not only logging/name decoration.
preservation: One complete external authority entitlement snapshot lifecycle, not one perUUID/character codec/scroll perk or cached list method. This is externally granted policy, NOT in-game earned progress, and it is read/write continuity with offline fallback, not old-key migration. The local snapshot owns recovered eligibility while fetch unavailable. Online successful response replaces prior snapshot rather than monotone union.
limits: Network NOT executed, no fresh remote/member list checked. Static source only; Java/game/world/sound untouched.

Online fetch fallback catches IOException only. JSON syntax/shape errors, invalid UUID, null map, branch parser runtime failure escape and can abort class initialization. Backup corrupt-line catch wraps RuntimeException, not IOException, so outer fallback does NOT catch that corruption. Empty file restores empty map. No blanket robust/corrupt-save success claim.

Encoding is reversible obfuscation, NOT encryption, signature or trusted entitlement proof. Local file editable, mutable public map returned, no authentication/integrity/expiry/revocation token. Shared GAMEDIR cache is not world-scoped or player-account bound. No recommendation to adopt donor privilege policy.

Fresh fetch completely replaces old map and rewrites file (not merge), removed member loses qualification only next classloader load; offline stale snapshot can retain revoked membership indefinitely. No periodic runtime refresh, network timeout or backoff in read source.

Backup FileUtils whole-file write is not temporary+rename or fsync journal; failed/interrupted save may truncate former fallback. Backup failure keeps fresh map current session but future offline loses it. Blank/malformed remote response not checked by stronger schema.

Death protection is actual consumer, but separate item cooldown/key and effects provide no new credit here. No full native ItemStack/Curios event ordering/cancellation interaction audited, no absolute protection guarantee. Parent permits only if no same curio; actual item registry source factory present but abstract registry framework internals not fully traced.

Snapshot list not proof of payment/purchase; no actual external granting process audited. One authority-policy backup mechanism maximum if coordinator agrees relevance; otherwise exploratory0. Does not justify deleting any production prompt or claim Dynasty acceptance.
